cases.name: A：速度列不存在
cases.sql: SELECT dat, start_us AS st, end_us AS et, car_series FROM raw_vehicle_events WHERE speed_kph < 1 AND end_us - start_us >= 3000000;

expected.cause: SQL 引用了不存在的 speed_kph；不得无证据更改单位或业务规则

cases.name: B：车系输出别名错误
cases.origin: Pipeline B / todo 同症状场景
cases.sql: SELECT dat, start_us AS st, end_us AS et, car_series AS vehicle_type FROM raw_vehicle_events WHERE speed_mps < 1 AND end_us - start_us >= 3000000;

expected.cause: 源列存在，但 SQL 将 car_series 输出为 vehicle_type

cases.name: 遗漏车系输出字段
cases.sql: SELECT dat, start_us AS st, end_us AS et FROM raw_vehicle_events WHERE speed_mps < 1 AND end_us - start_us >= 3000000;

expected.cause: SQL 投影遗漏 car_series；不能当作源表缺列或输入为空

cases.name: 车系列被空字符串表达式覆盖
cases.origin: todo 同症状场景的 SQL 变体
cases.sql: SELECT dat, start_us AS st, end_us AS et, '' AS car_series FROM raw_vehicle_events WHERE speed_mps < 1 AND end_us - start_us >= 3000000;

expected.cause: SQL 输出空字符串而非源 car_series；不能归因为真实源数据为空

cases.name: D：速度筛选被放宽
cases.sql: SELECT dat, start_us AS st, end_us AS et, car_series FROM raw_vehicle_events WHERE speed_mps < 20 AND end_us - start_us >= 3000000;

expected.cause: 速度条件不符合 <1 m/s 规则，SQL 成功但选入额外事件

cases.name: 时长边界误用严格大于
cases.sql: SELECT dat, start_us AS st, end_us AS et, car_series FROM raw_vehicle_events WHERE speed_mps < 1 AND end_us - start_us > 3000000;

expected.cause: >3000000 排除了恰好三秒的合法事件，应满足 >=3000000
